title: Implement a small Node.js function from a specification

prompt.zh: 请按 README.md 和 slug.mjs 注释中的要求实现 slugify。不要修改已有测试、README.md 或 package.json，也不要引入第三方依赖。完成后运行 `npm test` 确认通过。注意：评分时还会运行未公开的额外测试来检查规格中的边界情况。
prompt.en: Implement slugify as specified in README.md and the comment in slug.mjs. Do not modify the existing tests, README.md or package.json, and do not add third-party dependencies. Run `npm test` afterwards to confirm. Scoring also runs additional hidden tests for edge cases in the specification.
